claims: Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
Most banks in the U.S. remain open on Good Friday.
The NYSE is closed on Good Friday.
The Nasdaq is closed on Good Friday.
The Federal Reserve remains open on Good Friday.
Most commercial banks operate with regular business hours on Good Friday.
Most credit unions operate with regular business hours on Good Friday.
USPS operates normally on Good Friday.
UPS operates normally on Good Friday.
FedEx operates normally on Good Friday.
